source: cuad-v1 + boundaries from the 2026-11-16 error review (first10). Revision 2: Cap On Liability include removed (contradicted held-out labels), question-phrase terms for all evaluated categories. Decide on rest30 only.

includes: automatic or evergreen renewal after a fixed initial term
an extension one party can trigger by giving notice
excludes: an agreement with an indefinite or unlimited term that runs until a party terminates it (there is no initial term to renew)
an extension only by mutual agreement or renegotiation (any contract can be extended that way)

includes: a requirement of consent or notice before assignment
an outright prohibition on assigning or transferring the agreement or rights under it, including licensed rights that are not transferable
a restriction on a party competing, or operating in a market, geography, business or technology sector
excludes: a territory clause that only defines where a party sells or earns compensation
an exclusivity commitment not to work with or grant rights to third parties in a field (that is Exclusivity)
